summary: 72-year-old Montrose couple rolled their Jeep about 450 vertical feet off Tomboy Road near Royer Gulch (Imogene Pass area) en route to Telluride; multi-agency technical-rope rescue with rockfall threat (~35 people, ~5 hours) brought them out; both sustained multiple critical injuries, transported to Telluride Medical Center then flown by medical helicopter to St. Mary's Hospital in Grand Junction
location: Tomboy Road near Royer Gulch, Imogene Pass area, en route to Telluride
responding_agency: San Miguel County Sheriff's Office Search and Rescue
notes: DATE APPROXIMATE: pin is the story publication date (Mon 2019-08-19); sheriff release states the incident occurred 'some time before' the 911 call, exact day unstated; source quotes the San Miguel County Sheriff release verbatim; run-948 insert via SMCSO news-alerts chunk
